verdict.rationale: Elastic's own docs say it can create and track SLOs against performance targets, so the core SLO capability is first-party and direct. The pack does not document error budgets or burn-rate alerting specifically; the alerting docs describe only generic threshold and KQL rules. Missing for 10: documented error-budget tracking, documented burn-rate alert rules on SLOs, in-depth SLO configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can define SLOs with error budgets and burn-rate alerts

citations.quote: Elastic Observability allows for creating and tracking SLOs to ensure you meet your performance targets.
You can define rules at different levels (service, environment, transaction) or use custom KQL queries.
